claim: For the real Day--James plane \(X=\ell_3-\ell_1\) with \(\|(s,t)\|=(|s|^3+|t|^3)^{1/3}\) if \(st\ge0\) and \(\|(s,t)\|=|s|+|t|\) if \(st<0\), the Birkhoff--James orthogonal Schäffer constant satisfies \[g_\perp(X)=\inf_{x,y\in S_X,\ x\perp_B y}\max\{\|x-y\|,\|x+y\|\}=\left(1+\frac3{2^{4/3}}\right)^{1/3}.\] The value is attained at \(x=(2^{-1/3},2^{-1/3})\), \(y=(1/2,-1/2)\) and their norm-symmetry images.
integrity: The real two-dimensional unit sphere is exhausted by smooth cubic arcs, opposite-sign taxicab facets and nonsmooth axes; the Birkhoff--James support-functional analysis and strict inequalities prove the global minimum, with symbolic corroboration of the derivative factorization.
scientific_limitations: Only the real cubic Day--James plane and its Birkhoff--James orthogonal Schäffer constant; not the full ell_p--ell_1 family.
title: Exact orthogonal Schäffer constant of the cubic Day--James plane
